name: Pinned read-only export adapter
description: The preview consumes a repository-local senshac-content export pinned to full source revision d90fe0dd3b1fa968d81a40bc22d3ebd7ad650e99. adapter.mjs validates contractVersion and sourceRevision and returns discriminated ready, stale, missing, or error outcomes; the legacy fixture remains test-only. Refreshes require updating the immutable export and pin together with quality checks and owner review.

outcomes.notes: The current checked-in content export and adapter retain the same full pinned source revision; adapter handles version/revision mismatch and malformed exports.
outcomes.test_results: npm test 43/43; test/content.test.mjs passes the ready/stale/missing/error and project-route contract.

title: Keep Tina articles in sibling content repository
rationale: The articles collection uses localContentPath ../senshac-content while the web repository retains only a non-editorial fixture and the existing home export contract.

outcomes.notes: Tina's articles collection remains sourced from the sibling senshac-content checkout; repo-local content fixture/export stays a separate preview contract.
outcomes.test_results: Current tina/config.ts and scripts/tina-cli.mjs reviewed; npm test 43/43.

title: Regenerate tina-lock.json when the web schema changes
rationale: tina/tina-lock.json is tracked and drives the TinaCloud remote schema, but only 'tinacms dev' regenerates it; 'tinacms build' never does. PR #35 added the articles collection to tina/config.ts without regenerating the lock, so the CI cloud build diffed the local config schema against the remote (lock-derived) schema and failed the quality gate. Run 'tinacms dev --no-server --noWatch' after schema edits and commit the tracked lock; local '--local --skip-cloud-checks' builds hide the drift.

outcomes.notes: The current agent guide still requires regenerating tina/tina-lock.json through Tina dev after schema edits; the separate build/generate command is not treated as its substitute.
outcomes.test_results: npm run build succeeded; Tina lock check passed with 8 collections.

name: Pinned editorial project routes
description: The web export can carry a validated project index while the sibling senshac-content repository remains the editorial source; Astro generates project listing and slug routes from the adapter.

outcomes.notes: Current adapter exposes the pinned project index and generates listing/detail routes from it; the editorial source remains in senshac-content.
outcomes.test_results: npm test 43/43; test/content.test.mjs verifies adapter project slugs and route generation.
